text: The panel's answer, and only the panel's. The message is honest and reachable — the server distinguishes this case with its own error code before it spends quota — but two other shipped AI entry points hit the same server error and show nothing at all: Pages → SEO “Write with AI” and Media → “✨ Generate” both swallow the exception, flip the label back and leave the field blank. This board is not the product-wide answer until those two carry the same two sentences.
expect: Not hypothetical. A dev fallback that quietly succeeded is why AI was dead in pr
why: UX-G-05 + UX-G-15's board-side twin FIG-K-15(b). The board id and size (172:43, 280x72 @100,2498) ARE read; its CURRENT TEXT is not. | guard reset to the node's ACTUAL text: the plan's expect had collapsed whitespace, so the row refused while its id was correct.

UX-H-08 + UX-H-01 — Grid/List/Sort render permanently disabled with no tooltip (SlimLauncher.tsx:285-293, 'They light up with the folder work (T12)'), and bulk selection has no visible entry at all (SlimLauncher.tsx:469-476 steals right-click). Drop the two inert glyphs and the one-option view toggle; put the Select the drawer actually needs in their place. List view and sort stay where they work — the fullpage manager.
